summary: COSE (RFC 9052) has no direct way to use hash algorithms, but hashes are needed in places such as indirect signatures, where the hash of content is signed, and when identifying a certificate by its fingerprint. This document defines hash algorithms that are identified by COSE algorithm identifiers.

eli5.summary: A hash is like a short fingerprint of a long document. This document gives the COSE system names for several fingerprint recipes so messages can say which one they used.

questions: how to identify a certificate by hash in cose
